description: Wever Checks: submit document text (up to 256 KB) and get a signed report of every date and obligation in it. Each obligation is quoted with its offset, party, action, category and due date, relative period or unparsed due date; a timeline shows what is due when. Dates that could not be parsed (no year, no day, two-digit year, ambiguous day and month, or not a calendar day) are quoted with the reason. POST /api/deadline-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/checks/.

text.description: Document text, up to 256 KB: a contract, statement of work, policy, notice or schedule.

title.description: Optional document name, recorded in the report.
